title: Figures 4-5: B-2 Spirit stealth bomber and Boeing X-45A UCAV in flight
description: Two aviation photographs used as comparison aircraft in the BAASS UAP analysis report. Figure 4 shows a Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit Stealth Bomber flying over ocean and clouds; Figure 5 shows the Boeing Phantom Works X-45A stealth UCAV drone (DARPA/UCAV markings) over desert terrain.
